scenes.text: This tutorial covers Classify, computer vision. Train and apply an image-based neural network to annotated single-object crops.
Open Classify, computer vision from the Core section. Select annotated crop folders or a project database with reliable class labels.
In the main configuration area, choose the image channels, architecture, split strategy, augmentation, batch size, and training controls.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. train on the training split, monitor validation behavior, and evaluate once on held-out data.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR saves the model, metrics, predictions, class examples, and run metadata for later application.
